auth.title: Sign in
auth.description: Enter your email and password to continue.

items.title: Work items
items.count: No items loaded | {n} item loaded | {n} items loaded

detail.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the work item. This action cannot be undone.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Start with your name, email and a password.
register.name: Name

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Enter a new password for your account.
reset.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.
reset.doneDescription: You can now sign in with your new password.

verify.title: Email confirmation
verify.failed: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
verify.failedHint: Sign in and use “Resend confirmation email” to get a new link.

verifyBanner.text: Confirm your email address ({email}) to invite people to your workspaces.
verifyBanner.sent: A new confirmation link has been sent to {email}.

invitation.title: Join {workspace}
invitation.signInHint: Sign in to accept the invitation.
invitation.registerHint: Create an account with this email address to accept the invitation.
invitation.wrongAccountTitle: You are signed in with a different account
invitation.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {current}, but this invitation was sent to {invited}. Sign out, then sign in or register with that address.
invitation.invalid: This invitation has already been used, was withdrawn or has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.

welcome.title: Welcome, {name}
welcome.description: Create your first workspace. A workspace holds your team's projects and members.

create.title: Create a workspace
create.description: A separate space with its own projects and members.

fields.name: Workspace name
fields.slugHint: Your workspace will be available at {path}.
fields.slugRule: Use 2–40 lowercase letters and digits, separated by single hyphens.

notFound.title: Workspace not found
notFound.description: This workspace does not exist or you are not a member of it. Check the address or ask an admin to invite you.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Projects in {workspace}
projects.emptyDescription: Projects group related work items under a short key such as WEB. Once a project is created in this workspace, it will show up here.

members.title: Members
members.removeDescription: They lose access to this workspace immediately. You can invite them again later.
members.leaveDescription: You lose access to this workspace and need a new invitation to come back.

invitations.title: Invite people
invitations.description: They receive an email with a link that is valid for a few days.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.generalDescription: Rename the workspace or change its web address.
settings.readOnly: Only admins and owners can change these settings.
settings.slugHint: The workspace is available at {path}. Changing it breaks existing links.
settings.deleteDescription: Permanently removes the workspace with all its projects and members.
settings.deleteConfirm: Everything in this workspace is permanently removed for all members. This action cannot be undone.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.fetchOne: Failed to load the work item.
errors.create: Failed to create the work item.
errors.update: Failed to update the work item.
errors.delete: Failed to delete the work item.
